defaultValue: Dictates a message and hands it to the companion app for delivery.

items.label: Send after
items.description: How long the transcript stays on the review screen before it is sent. Pressing any button on the watch cancels the countdown.

items.label: Show what was sent
items.description: When a message goes out without you pressing Select, keep it on screen marked Sent. Select closes it, Back records again, and it closes by itself after 30 seconds unless you scroll.
